Market today:
The mood is cautious. While job creation might be rebounding, the real driver is the spiking 10-year Treasury yield, which directly pressures your tech and chip names by increasing borrowing costs and discounting future earnings.

Your holdings:
SOXL is a deep concern, down almost 59% and highly leveraged. SPAL, a new leveraged ETF, is also down significantly at 37%. SMH is down 14.61% and close to its stop. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch:
Keep a close eye on the 10-year Treasury yield for continued upward pressure. Also, Broadcom's upcoming earnings will set the tone for the chip sector.

Bottom line:
Prioritize managing your leveraged, underperforming positions and stay highly sensitive to interest rate movements.
plays: SOXL: Your -58.94% loss on this leveraged ETF is critical. Review your position and set a realistic stop or consider cutting losses, as decay and margin amplify this pain.
SPAL: This new leveraged ETF is down 37.24%. Respect its stop at 21.38 to prevent further deep losses.
SMH: Down 14.61% and marked TRIM. Its stop at 540 is very close; be ready to act if it breaks.
